mapper.select: SELECT event_id FROM platform_event FORCE INDEX(ix_event_delivery) WHERE status=#{status} AND available_at<#{cutoff} AND created_at<#{cutoff} ORDER BY available_at,event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM platform_inbox WHERE event_id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM platform_event WHERE status IN ('DELIVERED','SKIPPED') AND event_id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM platform_command WHERE created_at<#{cutoff} AND response_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(available_at) FROM platform_event FORCE INDEX(ix_event_delivery) WHERE status=#{status}
SELECT MIN(from_at) FROM platform_replay WHERE status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM platform_event FORCE INDEX(ix_event_delivery) WHERE status='PENDING' AND available_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND event_type IN #{t} LIMIT #{cap}) d
